Fixed in commit **[CENSORED!] Links to external GitHub repositories are not allowed** — `CloseProtocolSafe()` now uses safe cast (`as InterfaceControl`) instead of explicit cast, preventing `InvalidCastException` when the tab's Tag contains a `ConnectionInfo` (disconnected state).

Duplicate of #20/#25/#33 — same root cause.
